Grounding: Not supported; the printed output is wrong. So issue.

Overreach: No causal claim, just descriptive fraction. So fine.

Unacknowledged data problems: The data has sentinel -999 for biomarker, but not relevant to responded. Duplicates handled as per spec. No missing in responded. So fine.

False premise: No.

Thus verdict: revise. Issues: "grounding" (numeric claim not in output) and "output mismatch" (printed output shows site array not fraction). Provide issues list.
